intro: Cameroon is a presidential republic where Paul Biya has ruled since 1982.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The president is elected for seven years with no term limits. Opposition parties exist but face restrictions. The 2025 election result was disputed, leading to protests.

chapters.title: Anglophone crisis
text: Separatists in the North-West and South-West regions are fighting government forces.
